prompt_patches.patch_text: When handling Enum_Grounding, add a minimal self-check before final JSON output.
prompt_patches.expected_effect: Reduce enum grounding and arg_type failures by enforcing exact enum value copying and correct argument formatting.
prompt_patches.validation_scope: Rows with enum grounding and arg_type failures
success_criteria: strict DET score improves without new invalid JSON failures
prompt_patches.micro_rule: For ENUM arguments, copy one allowed enum value exactly; for numeric arguments, use unquoted numeric literals; preserve positional argument order and separator required by the schema.

prompt_patches.patch_text: When handling Service_Mapping, add a minimal self-check before final JSON output.
prompt_patches.expected_effect: Fix unknown_service and canonical_service_name failures by enforcing exact canonical service member usage.
prompt_patches.validation_scope: Rows with unknown_service and canonical_service_name failures
success_criteria: strict DET score improves without new invalid JSON failures
prompt_patches.micro_rule: Include every service family implied by the command, including both sensor reads and actuator actions; do not substitute a semantically adjacent service unless the schema requires it. Use canonical service member names exactly as in schema without concatenation or modification.

prompt_patches.patch_text: When handling Minimality, add a minimal self-check before final JSON output.
prompt_patches.expected_effect: Reduce extraneous failures by limiting output to command-required elements.
success_criteria: strict DET score improves without new invalid JSON failures
prompt_patches.micro_rule: Emit only actions and reads required by the command; remove unrelated reads, duplicate actions, invented wrappers, and unnecessary state changes.

prompt_patches.patch_text: When handling DET_Helper, add a minimal self-check before final JSON output.
prompt_patches.expected_effect: Improve detection and repair of gt_mismatch, gt_receiver_coverage, gt_service_coverage, and semantic failures.
prompt_patches.validation_scope: Rows with gt_mismatch and coverage failures
success_criteria: strict DET score improves without new invalid JSON failures
prompt_patches.micro_rule: When the code is schema-valid but not target-equivalent, compare receiver coverage, service coverage, temporal structure, dataflow, numeric units, and enum grounding before final output.

prompt_patches.patch_text: When handling Owner_Device_Rule, add a minimal self-check before final JSON output.
prompt_patches.expected_effect: Fix gt_receiver_coverage failures by ensuring all implied tags are preserved.
success_criteria: strict DET score improves without new invalid JSON failures
prompt_patches.micro_rule: Preserve every command-implied device, owner, location, group, sector, and selector tag in the receiver expression unless the command explicitly broadens the target.

prompt_patches.patch_text: When handling Skeleton, add a minimal self-check before final JSON output.
prompt_patches.expected_effect: Improve semantic and precondition failures by correct skeleton classification and explicit precondition representation.
prompt_patches.validation_scope: Rows with semantic and precondition failures
success_criteria: strict DET score improves without new invalid JSON failures
prompt_patches.micro_rule: Choose the JOILang skeleton by first classifying the command as one-shot, condition-action, edge-trigger, cron schedule, period loop, or trigger-then-repeat. Represent explicit state preconditions as guard conditions before the action; do not infer state from unrelated mode values or replace a state check with an action.
